# Ellie Jones — elliej.dev

> Director of Analytics at Wyvern. Data Scientist, Software Developer & Photographer based in Calgary, AB.

## About

Ellie Jones leads analytics at Wyvern, a company building hyperspectral satellite imagery products. She works across data science, software development, geospatial analysis, and photography.

## Pages

- [Home](https://elliej.dev/) — Portfolio landing page with featured projects and contour line visualizations
- [Photography](https://elliej.dev/photography/) — Photography gallery featuring landscape, portrait, and documentary work
- [Blog](https://elliej.dev/blog/) — Writing about geospatial data science, creative coding, and side projects

## Projects

- [streamlit-plotly-events](https://github.com/null-jones/streamlit-plotly-events) — Streamlit component that allows Plotly events to bubble back up to Streamlit
- [awesome-hyperspectral](https://github.com/Nrevyw/awesome-hyperspectral) — Curated list of projects, papers, and tools for working with hyperspectral imagery
- [wyvern-public-resources](https://github.com/Nrevyw/wyvern-public-resources) — Tutorials, examples, and tools for working with Wyvern Hyperspectral Data
- [Contourist](https://github.com/null-jones/contourist) — Web-based topographic joy/ridgeline plot generator
